name: io.github.pandafileco/pandafile-mcp
title: Pandafile
description: Send big files and folders with a link, manage transfers and file requests on pandafile.co.

environmentVariables.name: PANDAFILE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Pandafile API key (pf_live_… or pf_test_… for test mode). Create one in Dashboard → Domain & API (Pro or Team).

environmentVariables.name: PANDAFILE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL (default https://pandafile.co/api/v1). Only for testing.
